raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The graph is a line chart that displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers. The X-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, while the Y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. There are three lines on the graph, each representing a different condition: the sparsity ratio before the gate, the sparsity ratio after the gate, and the sparsity ratio after the average gate. The line for the sparsity ratio before the gate is a dashed blue line with an average value of 0.03. The line for the sparsity ratio after the gate is a dotted orange line with an average value of 0.44. The line for the sparsity ratio after the average gate is a dash-dot green line with an average value of 0.33. The lines show a general trend of decreasing sparsity ratio as the layer number increases, with some fluctuations.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: The line chart illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, while the y-axis shows the sparsity ratio, which varies from 0.0 to 1.0. There are three lines representing different conditions: the sparsity ratio before the gate, after the gate, and after the average gate, each with an average value indicated. The line for the sparsity ratio before the gate starts at a high value and decreases sharply, ending at an average of 0.03. The line for the sparsity ratio after the gate begins at a lower value, increases, and then fluctuates, ending at an average of 0.44. The line for the sparsity ratio after the average gate starts at a moderate value, decreases, and then shows a slight increase towards the end, ending at an average of 0.33. The chart does not include any data points, peaks, or troughs beyond the average values.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The line plot titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2" illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is also linear and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. There are three lines in the plot, each representing a different condition. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," starts at a sparsity ratio of 0.03 and remains relatively flat across the layers. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," starts at a sparsity ratio of 0.44 and shows a general decline with some fluctuations, ending at a value slightly above 0.2. The green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," starts at a sparsity ratio of 0.33 and follows a similar declining trend to the orange line, with more pronounced fluctuations, ending at a value slightly below 0.2. The plot does not provide any additional context or data points beyond the average values and the general trends of the sparsity ratios.
